defects.mechanism: public-surface resolution lattice hand-maintained instead of generated; runtime lattice (vite valueJsSelfAlias) IS generated from package.json#exports, typecheck lattice is not — the asymmetry is the bug
defects.proposedCure: Generate tsconfig.demo.json#paths from package.json#exports with the SAME generator vite.config.ts already uses for valueJsSelfAlias — one map, one generator, two consumers. defects.defect: The component calls a glass-ui API that does not exist: `<Skeleton surface="glass" variant="shimmer">` ×3. glass-ui 7.0.0's Skeleton declares exactly one prop (`class`) and its compiled CSS carries a single unconditional recipe with no variant selectors. The props fall through as inert non-standard HTML attributes. Nothing catches it because strictTemplates is off (L-2).
defects.evidence: Markdown.vue:2-8 (comment 'glass shimmer bones, not opaque pulse blocks' + 3 call sites with surface/variant). node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/skeleton/Skeleton.vue.d.ts: `type __VLS_Props = { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] };`. Compiled CSS (glass-ui.css): `.skeleton[data-v-cd03d0b0]{isolation:isolate;border-radius:var(--radius-input);background:var(--muted);position:relative;overflow:hidden}` plus two unconditional ::after rules — no [surface=]/[variant=]/.shimmer selectors exist (`grep -o 'skeleton[^{,]*\|shimmer[^{,]*' glass-ui.css | sort -u` → skeleton, skeleton-scan-cd03d0b0, skeleton-title, .skeleton[data-v-cd03d0b0], :after only). `grep -n 'strictTemplates' tsconfig*.json` → no match. Second-order: glass-ui fills the skeleton with var(--muted) — the exact tone this component's own style block (Markdown.vue:229-232) rules must NEVER be used ('never the parallel --muted species, which stepped OPPOSITE the well in dark').
defects.mechanism: a design intent expressed through a non-existent prop API; it looks correct only because shimmer is glass-ui's unconditional default, so the props are noise that would keep 'working' if glass-ui changed it — and the gate that should catch it is disabled
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js; cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/skeleton/Skeleton.vue.d.ts; grep -o '\.skeleton\[data-v-cd03d0b0\][^}]*}' node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/glass-ui.css; sed -n '2,8p' demo/scenes/about/markdown/Markdown.vue; grep -n 'strictTemplates' tsconfig*.json
defects.proposedCure: Enable vueCompilerOptions.strictTemplates (makes this a compile error), then delete the two dead props. If the skeleton genuinely must seat on --well-bg rather than --muted, that is a glass-ui change per edict 4 — a variant added in glass-ui, never a demo per-instance override.

result.strongestDefect: L-1 — the demo typechecks `@mkbabb/value.js/css` against the published npm 4.0.0 tarball (Package ID proven by traceResolution) while running against the local working-tree build, whose css.d.ts differs by 32 lines and forks the core `Color` type into private duplicates (`Color_2`, `Channel_2`, `SpaceId_2`). `tsconfig.demo.json#paths` has 3 phantom entries pointing at files that do not exist and omits 2 real published subpaths (`/css`, `/value`). 9 demo files are affected; the subject's composable straddles the seam on adjacent lines 3 and 4. The demo is the repo's only proof that the published API is usable — for `/css` that proof is false, and the V·π parser mini-tranche is about to edit exactly the code the demo typecheck cannot see.
result.negativeProof: Not SOUND, but these specific suspicions were tested and disproved, and are recorded as the negative in the report: (1) The value.js import SPECIFIERS are correct — `@mkbabb/value.js/color` and `@mkbabb/value.js/css` (useMarkdownColors.ts:3-4) are both real keys in package.json#exports, and `grep -rn '@src' demo/ assets/` returns nothing, so there is no deep src/ reach anywhere in this component's graph; a real consumer could write those two lines verbatim (the defect is the resolution lattice, not the specifier). (2) `verbatimModuleSyntax` is honoured — Markdown.vue:40 `import type { DocModule }`, useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:1 `import type { ShallowRef }`; zero mixed imports across the three files. (3) Vue 3.5 idioms are correct — useTemplateRef (Markdown.vue:50, Katex.vue:27), reactive props destructure (Markdown.vue:44, Katex.vue:22), getters passed into composables (Markdown.vue:52-53) rather than leaking props. (4) The named historical suspect 'three parallel useDark stores' is DEAD as a defect: `grep -rn 'useDark|useGlobalDark' demo/` yields 9 call sites, ALL `useGlobalDark` from `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dark` (the App.vue singleton); no vueuse useDark survives in demo/. The comment at useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:76 describes a cure that landed. (5) `Alert` is not a local re-implementation — demo/ui/alert/index.ts genuinely re-exports glass-ui's primitive (the shim TREE is the defect, not duplicated component logic). (6) No duplicate markdown renderer exists — `grep -rn 'Markdown' demo/` finds exactly one component and one consumer (AboutPane.vue:50). (7) The `:deep()` reach is legitimate: it targets content this repo compiles (unplugin-vue-markdown output), not a shadcn internal — the distinction demo/DESIGN.md draws; the rationale at Markdown.vue:81-97 is accurate. (8) Katex.vue:20's script-side stylesheet import is correct and its cure is real — the live DOM shows 9 `.katex` and 4 `.katex-display` nodes rendering.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt on `demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue` (the generic slider-pane behind /#/atmosphere and /#/blob)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`, the tier this seat was explicitly spawned with. Declared, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: C-1 — `resetDefaults()` is `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))`, a depth-1 shallow merge. It preserves runtime state at depth 1 (AuroraPane's `seed`, absent from defaults — the documented intent) and DESTROYS it at depth 2: one click on Reset in BlobPane silently replaces the live picker-derived ramp `["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"]` with the producer's canned `["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"]`, because `color.paletteStops` lives inside a `color` key that IS on defaults. The writer (`useAtmosphere.ts:389-403`) is keyed on the colour string, so the picker→blob palette link stays severed until a DIFFERENT colour is picked. Both consumer files declare in prose that this state must survive Reset; the implementation honours that promise only by accident of nesting depth.
result.negativeProof: n/a — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Negative proofs for the hazards that did NOT fire are tabulated in the report's "What I checked and found sound" section: no defineModel, no colour maths, no ValueUnit, no rAF/timers/listeners/observers at all in the file, no canvas, no parser, zero horizontal overflow, zero nameless buttons contributed, aurora Reset correctly preserves `seed`, keyboard operable with a visible ring, min/max clamping and step honoured, verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied, 252 lines so no god module.)

defects.defect: Unguarded dot-path read: `read()` casts a possibly-`undefined` path result to `number` and `fmt()` calls `.toFixed` on it during render. Type permits the state: AuroraAtoms.zones is optional and the def is {key:"zones.count"} (AuroraPane.vue:103). Internal inconsistency: AuroraPane guards the same key 3 lines away — `atoms.zones?.arrangement ?? "composed"` (:74) and `atoms.zones?.count ?? 4` (:82).

Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')", configConsoleStillMounted:false, rowsAfter:0, pageErrors:[], consoleNoise:[]. defects.proposedCure: Delete the reflection layer. Give `SliderDef` its own `get: () => number` / `set: (n:number) => void` (or a typed lens): the class becomes unrepresentable and `readPath`/`writePath`/the `as number`/both `as unknown as` casts all disappear — strictly less code.

defects.proposedCure: Fold into the F1 cure: retire variant="spectrum" so the producer's `.slider-range` paints the value, delete ConfigSliderPane.vue:202 and :204-206, and let glass-ui's Slider own a forced-colors arm — `border: 1px solid` on `.slider-track`, `.slider-range { background: Highlight; forced-color-adjust: none }`, and `outline` (not box-shadow) for :focus-visible. Producer change, not demo (edict 4).

defects.defect: Below 1024px the entire Blob configurator leaves the DOM; the sole purpose of /blob is unreachable at mobile widths and at 200% zoom, behind a global pane toggle the canon names a live defect.
defects.evidence: WebKit breakpoint sweep on /#/blob (scratchpad/chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> breakpointSweep): 1440/1280/1100/1024 => .config-console present, 31 rows; 1000/900/768/600/390 => absent, 0 rows. Corroborated: REPORT.json safari-mobile-light /#/blob bodyTextLength 69, allElements 228 (vs 713/642 desktop), smallTapTargets limited to L/A/B/ALPHA channel. shots/safari-mobile-light/blob.png and shots/zoom-200-desktop/blob.png both show the Picker plus a Dock `Picker | Blob` toggle with Picker selected. visual/states.mjs:21-22 captures zoom-200 as a 720x450 viewport at DPR 2.
defects.mechanism: The pane has no narrow arm of its own and inherits the shell's global pane toggle. OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:115 names a frame showing a "global pane toggle" a live defect; VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:32 law 6 says "no global pane selector ... survives". The pane's other consumer (/atmosphere) DOES render at 390px (rowCount 3), so one generic pane has two divergent, unspecified narrow behaviours.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob at 1000px viewport width; or at 1440px with browser zoom 200%
defects.proposedCure: The pane owns its narrow composition instead of inheriting a toggle: an always-rendered `essentials` region plus a scroll-confined `advanced` disclosure (the OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:47 mobile sequence preview;essentials;advanced/reset/compare), which requires the D-9 API change. W19 deletes the Dock Picker|Blob toggle in the same cut.

defects.defect: No slider in the pane indicates its value: the producer's fill element is correctly sized and paints nothing, while the inert track is painted from a body-text ink token so it reads as 100% filled.
defects.evidence: /#/atmosphere 1440x900, Colour Energy 0.760 of 0..1 (scratchpad/chD-csp-probe.mjs): .slider-track w962 h24 backgroundColor oklch(0.4469 0.0039 34.63) backgroundImage none; .slider-range width 731 (=76.0%, exactly the value) backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0) backgroundImage none opacity 1; [role=slider] w12 h24 backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0). Contrast via 1x1 canvas sRGB round-trip: track vs well 5.82:1 light / 8.30:1 dark — identical to the live readout ink (same token). Visible in shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png (Body Radius 0.220 and Satellites 3 are identical bars) and shots/safari-mobile-dark/atmosphere.png (near-white slab brighter than the display title).
defects.mechanism: ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 sets variant="spectrum" — the producer's chromatic-rail recipe whose `.slider-range` is transparent by design because a gradient supplies the value read. :198-199 admits it ("the spectrum .slider-range is transparent by recipe so no filled/unfilled split reads either") and ships anyway. :202 then re-inks the information-free track with `--ink-muted`, amplifying the empty channel. Figure and ground invert: the background reads as the filled value, the thumb as a hole punched in it. Diagnosed twice historically and cured neither time (N/audit/lanes2/U-CONTROLS.md:54; N/waves/N.W13.md:28).
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob at >=1024px; compare the Satellites (3) and Body Radius (0.220) rows — two visually identical bars.
defects.proposedCure: Architectural transposition, net deletion: drop variant="spectrum", consume the producer's default neutral Slider so `.slider-range` paints the filled extent from producer tokens. `--slider-track-bg` (:202) and the `:deep(.configurator-row .font-mono)` re-ink (:204-206) then both delete, because the contrast problem they were invented for stops existing — the fill becomes the >=3:1 object and the track returns to a quiet groove. Fixes D-1, D-4 and D-14 with the same cut.

defects.defect: A certified text-ink token (`--ink-muted`, specified at >=4.5:1 for glyph mass) is used as a ~23,000px2 area fill, making the inert track the pane's heaviest and near-loudest object.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:202 `--slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground))`. Measured (chD-csp-probe2.mjs): track vs well 5.82:1 light / 8.30:1 dark; row label vs well 13.52:1 / 9.28:1; section heading 5.08:1 / 5.97:1. In dark mode the inert track sits within one stop of the label. Track geometry 962x24 on /atmosphere, 432x24 on /blob.
defects.mechanism: Text ink is specified for a few-hundred-px2 glyph mass; applied to continuous surface it is a different optical object — it reads as a painted bar, not a groove at adequate contrast. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:14-16 (tier separation: instrument veil vs specimen well) and :21 ("Dark chrome uses the restrained neutral pole"). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:73 law 8: "Real rendered relation wins over token intent ... token presence alone cannot close a row" — the comment at :190-201 closes its row on token presence.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> contrast-light / contrast-dark
defects.proposedCure: Fold into D-3. The track's material belongs to the producer Slider's neutral recipe at its own graphics rung; if that rung is genuinely below 3:1 on --well-bg, the fix is a glass-ui `--slider-track-*` token pair sized for area, not a consumer re-ink borrowed from the text ladder.

defects.defect: 31 slider thumbs render 12x24px — below the WCAG 2.5.8 24x24 minimum on the inline axis — and the component's hit-area extension is gated to `@media (pointer: coarse)`, so desktop is uncovered.
defects.evidence: REPORT.json safari-desktop-light /#/blob a11y.smallTapTargets: 39 entries, 31 of them exactly {w:12,h:24,tag:"span"} labelled with every BlobPane slider (Body Radius ... Speed). Identical in safari-desktop-dark. Live: thumb {w:12,h:24} at both 1440 and 390. Cure gate: ConfigSliderPane.vue:218-230. Mobile arm proves the cure works (REPORT.json safari-mobile-light channel spans h:44; /atmosphere mobile rows h 57.59).
defects.mechanism: WCAG 2.5.8 is not pointer-type-conditional. The coarse-only guard leaves pointer:fine uncovered, and on /blob the coarse arm is dead code anyway because the pane is not rendered at coarse-pointer widths (D-2). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:72 law 7 explicitly licenses extending the operable target without growing the visual glyph.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob at 1440px; inspect any [role="slider"] inside .config-console — 12x24 CSS px.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the `pointer: coarse` guard and move the hit extension onto the glass-ui Slider thumb (unconditional), retiring the consumer `:deep()` block entirely. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:56 PR-12 already owns this family at W18.

defects.defect: The pane emits 8 dividing lines on /blob where the binding boundary inventory specifies `none`, and the section rule is scheme-asymmetric: invisible in light (1.08:1), a hard rule in dark (5.03:1).
defects.evidence: Live /#/blob: sectionHeaders 7, actionBars 1 = 8 lines. Sources: ConfigSliderPane.vue:232-235 (.config-section-header border-bottom, one per section) and :245-251 (.config-action-bar border-top). OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:80-81 gives Atmosphere and Blob `Retained non-P122 dividing line: none`; :90 "Any additional line ... is a defect". Measured divider vs well: 1.08:1 light, 5.03:1 dark (chD-csp-probe2.mjs).
defects.mechanism: Duplicative boundary: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:69 law 4 retains a divider only when grouping would be ambiguous without it, and the pane already separates sections with gap-5 plus a distinct heading. `color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 50%, transparent)` over --well-bg is invisible in one scheme and crisp in the other, a 4.7x swing for one element. Under forced colors this forbidden rule is the only surviving element in the pane (D-1) — a precise inversion of design priority.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> contrast-light.dividerVsWell / contrast-dark.dividerVsWell; visual: shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png vs shots/safari-desktop-dark/blob.png under GEOMETRY.
defects.proposedCure: Delete both rules (:232-235, :250). Grouping is carried by heading plus interval, exactly the `Grouping job` column of the §5 inventory; the action bar's separation is carried by the material change at the well edge plus the Dock pill's own geometry.

defects.defect: A section heading and a control label are computed-identical (6/6 properties), the section heading is the same size as the row labels it groups, and the closed type matrix is breached in three roles.
defects.evidence: /#/atmosphere 1440x900 (chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> twoSpecies.identicalRecipe): .config-section-title (ConfigSliderPane.vue:237-243) vs .aurora-row-label (AuroraPane.vue:194-199) — fontFamily, fontSize (16.4px), textTransform (uppercase), letterSpacing (1.64px), color rgb(112,89,66), fontWeight 400 — all six equal, and the two CSS blocks are byte-identical in five declarations in the same order. Sizes: section title 16.4px == row label 16.4px (desktop) and 14px == 14px (390px); value 11px at both. Label/value ratio drifts 1.49 (desktop) -> 1.27 (mobile).
defects.mechanism: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:66-78 is a closed type matrix. Section heading must be text-heading/Plus Jakarta Sans — rendered Fira Code 16.4px caps. Control label must be text-small PJS non-bold — rendered Fira Code caps in the slot rows and PJS weight 500 in the well rows. Value must be text-mono-small or mono-caption — rendered text-micro 11px, neither token. Mono is thus louder as a heading (16.4px) than as the data it groups (11px), and FIELD vs HARMONY are indistinguishable in the frame.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> twoSpecies.identicalRecipe / .secTitles / .rowLabels; visual: shots/safari-mobile-dark/atmosphere.png (FIELD and HARMONY render identically).
defects.proposedCure: One matrix line per role: section headings -> text-heading (Plus Jakarta Sans), restoring a real size step above the row label; the mono/caps/tracking recipe survives in exactly one place, the value/provenance voice. The duplicated .aurora-row-label block dies with the slot cure (D-13). The value's size token moves to text-mono-small and rides the same container clamp as the label so the pair holds its ratio.

defects.defect: The pane roots a glass Card containing a second bordered, radiused opaque sub-card, on two compositions whose binding rows specify Card count 0 and forbid a settings Card stack by name.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:17 imports Card (demo/ui/card/index.ts is a one-line glass-ui re-export); :99-101 `<Card tier="resting" ...>` is the pane root; :122 nests .console-well (demo/styles/foundation.css:350-354: background --well-bg, 1px solid --card-edge, --radius-panel). Live ancestor walk from .console-well on /#/blob: [{tag:"DIV", m:["glass-resting"]}], wells: 1. OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:67 "the other sixteen compositions have Card count `0`"; :46 Atmosphere "form sections not Cards"; :47 Blob "no settings Card stack".
defects.mechanism: A configuration form is a page region, not a bounded specimen. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:19 "One surface has one tier. An inner card is not automatically another pane of glass." PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:66 law 1 "a mere padding group does not become a Card by default." foundation.css:339-348 concedes the point: .console-well is an "INTERIM demo class — swaps onto the producer .glass-well rung when packet P3 ships", i.e. a re-minted producer primitive with the swap booked rather than met (edict 4 deferred).
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> blobCounts.paneAncestorGlassClasses and .wells
defects.proposedCure: Compose InstrumentChassis' inspector region directly and drop both shells. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:38: "value.js composes regions with domain content; it does not clone a local chassis recipe." Row grouping then comes from the chassis region interval, which is also what retires D-6's dividers and D-13's dual indent.

defects.defect: The canon-required essentials/advanced/compare composition is unrepresentable: `SliderSection` has no disclosure axis, so 31 rows ship flat in a 695px window behind a hard clip with no fade.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:27-39 — `SliderDef {key,label,min,max,step}`, `SliderSection {title,defs}`; no rank/collapsed/compare/disabled/unit/format. Live /#/blob: scrollHeight 2605, clientHeight 695 (3.7 screens), maskImage "none", webkitMaskImage "none", scroll-region bottom 799 == action-bar top 799. OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:46-47 names the regions (Atmosphere preview;essentials;advanced — Blob preview;essentials;advanced/reset/compare); VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:51-52,214; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:54 PR-10.
defects.mechanism: The API makes the canonical composition impossible for any consumer, which is the difference between a missing feature and a design defect. The `maskImage:none` measurement also falsifies the component's own comment at :104-106 ("The scroll region owns the fade mask") and the class name pane-scroll-fade — that class sets only `contain` and `scroll-timeline`. Visible consequence: shots/safari-mobile-dark/atmosphere.png shows `Noise 0.500` with its control amputated at a hard edge.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> scrollRegion; visual: http://localhost:9000/#/blob at 1440x900, bottom of the well.
defects.proposedCure: `SliderSection` gains a disclosure disposition — `{title, rank: "essential"|"advanced", defs}` — with advanced sections composed into glass-ui's existing configurator disclosure surface (the producer already ships .configurator-layer-region with a PRM-guarded grid-template-rows transition). `compare` and a real reset land as the pane's action region per OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:47.

defects.defect: Two actions with zero result state: Copy JSON has no success, failure or pending truth (and swallows rejections), and Reset is destructive, unconfirmed, irreversible, with no compare.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-94. Live /#/blob: actions.btns = [{text:"Copy JSON", aria:null, disabled:false},{text:"Reset", aria:null, disabled:false}]; actions.liveRegions finds only the Picker's four channel meters at aria-live="off" — the pane emits no status region at all. `@click="copyAsJson"` on an async function means a writeClipboard rejection is an unhandled promise rejection; every other demo call site marks intent with `void writeClipboard(...)` (ColorPicker.vue:325, ColorInput.vue:222, usePaletteActions.ts:134).
defects.mechanism: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:101 "Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace. A transient flourish ... never carries the only truth" — here there is no truth at all; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:52 PR-08 is the standing row. The whole interaction grammar (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:96) is select -> tune -> commit; this pane has no commit stage — every drag writes straight into the injected config (:81) and Reset is the only exit. OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:47 requires a `compare` region that does not exist.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob -> deny clipboard permission -> click Copy JSON: nothing happens, no error surfaces. Click Reset: 31 values change with no confirmation, announcement or undo.
defects.proposedCure: One durable status region in the action bar owned by the pane (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:101); Reset becomes Reset + Compare with the canon's destructive-confirmation grammar; copyAsJson gains explicit success/failure arms.

defects.defect: The live readout has neither tabular figures nor reserved width, and infers precision from the value instead of the statically-known step — producing a ~27px live width jitter mid-drag on nearly every slider.
defects.evidence: Live /#/blob: readout fontVariantNumeric "normal"; "3" = 6.8px, "0.220" = 33.9px, "0.038" = 33.9px; in-place swap "0.220"->"-0.0005" = 32.1 -> 43.7px (delta +11.6px). ConfigSliderPane.vue:84-86 `fmt(v) = Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(3)`. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:78: "Live numbers use tabular figures and reserve their widest legal representation so value changes never reflow the settled chassis."
defects.mechanism: Precision derived from the value, not the def. Every BlobPane slider whose range contains an integer (warpAmp 0-1, eccentricity 0-0.5, noiseFreq 0.5-10.0, pulseFreq 0-2, specStrength 0-2, rimPower 1-5, iridescence/sssScale/coreGlow 0-1, pointerAttraction -1..1, stretch 0-1.5, tempo 0.25-2.5, ...) flips its readout between 5 chars and 1 char mid-drag — a ~80% width swing on a 33.9px element. `noiseFreq` step 0.1 renders `0.500`, two digits of false precision on 8 of 31 rows. No `unit` field exists, so `Merge (ms)` smuggles its unit into the label while `Hue Range` (degrees) has none, against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:124 ("announce label, value, unit").
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> truncation.readoutWidthShift; chD-csp-probe.mjs -> reflow. Visually: drag Warp on /#/blob through 1.00.
defects.proposedCure: `SliderDef` declares `precision` (or derives it once from `step`) and `unit`; the readout gets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and a min-inline-size reserved from the widest legal string. Both belong on glass-ui's ConfiguratorRow value slot — VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:104 already assigns the axis composition ("label, unit, reserved live value, ...") to the producer.

defects.defect: The declared "ONE RHYTHM SOURCE" container clamp is measurably inert — rendered row height is identical at container widths differing by 2.03x — and it bypasses the producer's real sizing API with utility classes plus a :deep() correction.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:208-217 `min-block-size: clamp(2rem, 7cqi, 2.625rem)`. Measured (chD-csp-probe.mjs): /atmosphere container 1042px -> resolved 42px, rendered row 60.94px; /blob container 512px -> resolved 35.84px, rendered row 60.94px; /atmosphere 390px container 358px -> 32px, rendered 57.59px. distinctRowHeights = [60.9] on both desktop arms. Separately dataSize: null on every row, while glass-ui.css ships `.configurator-row[data-size=sm|md|lg]` with --configurator-row-gap-* / --configurator-row-py-* plus an @container style(--configurator-size) seam.
defects.mechanism: The row content box (label line + gap-1.5 + 24px track + py-1) always exceeds the clamp, so the clamp never binds and the claim at :208-214 is false — the rhythm is fixed, not container-scaled, contrary to VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:33 law 7. The actual spacing comes from `class="gap-1.5 py-1"` (:142), replacing the producer's ladder, plus a `:deep()` descendant correction that VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:89 says W17 deletes.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe.mjs -> compare desktop-atmosphere.row0 / desktop-blob.row0 / mobile-atmosphere.row0
defects.proposedCure: Delete :215-217 and :142. Pass the producer's `size` (or set --configurator-size once on .config-console) and let the producer's gap/padding ladder own the rhythm. If the rhythm must be container-scaled, that clamp belongs in the producer's --configurator-row-py-* tokens so every consumer inherits one law — which is what "ONE RHYTHM SOURCE" was meant to mean.

defects.defect: The bare unnamed `<slot />` licenses a second control-row species in the same pane: 15px different indent, 1.69x different height, two type families at two weights and two colours, on two material tiers, with ragged control columns.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:110 (bare slot); AuroraPane.vue:118-181 fills it. Measured /#/atmosphere 1440x900 (chD-csp-probe3.mjs): .aurora-row left 224 right 1216 height 36px, label Fira Code 400 uppercase rgb(112,89,66), on the Card, controls `space-between` so four triggers form no column; .configurator-row left 239 right 1201 height 60.9px, label Plus Jakarta Sans 500 normal-case rgb(28,25,23), inside .console-well. .aurora-row-label (AuroraPane.vue:194-199) is a byte-copy of .config-section-title (ConfigSliderPane.vue:237-243).
defects.mechanism: The pane owns a row grammar and a heading grammar and exposes neither to the slot, so the consumer re-minted the nearest recipe it could see — the duplication is the tell. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:33 law 7 (no fork), :104 (one producer axis composition) and edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system; do not re-mint a row). ConfigSliderPane.vue:3 also documents a prop `extraControls?` that :41-52 never declares — the API drifted from its own header comment.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> twoSpecies.auroraRows vs twoSpecies.cwRows, twoSpecies.auroraLabels vs twoSpecies.rowLabels; visual: shots/safari-desktop-light/atmosphere.png.
defects.proposedCure: The slot must expose rows, not a blank region: a `sections` entry accepts an enum/select def alongside slider defs so every control in the pane is one ConfiguratorRow, in one grid, one material tier, one indent. AuroraPane.vue:118-181 and its whole <style> block delete with it — a real subtraction, no new directory and no wrapper component (edict 3).

defects.defect: The spectral-meniscus material — reserved by the constitution for genuinely chromatic domains (Picker and Gradient only) — is applied unconditionally to 34 geometry, material and time axes.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 `variant="spectrum"` for all 31 BlobPane defs and all 3 AuroraPane defs; live `data-variant="spectrum"` on every .glass-slider in .config-console. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:7: "the spectral meniscus: a continuous liquid-color rail reserved for genuinely chromatic continuous domains — Picker and Gradient." Domains actually driven: Body Radius, Smooth K, Rim Power, Shininess, Merge (ms), Zones.
defects.mechanism: Applying the reserved signature form to non-chromatic domains devalues the signature, and — because the variant blanks .slider-range by recipe — is the direct cause of D-3's missing value read. The record shows it was diagnosed twice and cured neither time: docs/tranches/N/audit/lanes2/U-CONTROLS.md:54 and docs/tranches/N/waves/N.W13.md:28 ("a spectrum slider with no spectrum"); the T.W8 cure at :190-202 fed the variant an ink instead of retiring the variant.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob; inspect data-variant on any .config-console .glass-slider
defects.proposedCure: Retire variant="spectrum" from this pane and consume the producer's neutral Slider (see D-3). The spectral meniscus returns to Picker and Gradient only.

defects.defect: Dependent-control state was never designed: at Satellites = 0, five sliders control nothing yet remain fully enabled, focusable and draggable with live readouts.
defects.evidence: BlobPane.vue:59-62 and :111-112 — satelliteCount range 0..4; satelliteRadius, orbitRadius, eccentricity, mergeDuration, emergeDuration all satellite-dependent. ConfigSliderPane.vue:27-33 `SliderDef` has no `disabled` field and the template renders no disabled state; live probe shows aria-disabled: null on every thumb.
defects.mechanism: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:83: "Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only. Role, accessible name, state/value and associated error/status are explicit." There is no disabled state to be colour-only with — the state does not exist in the model, so five controls silently lie about their effect.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/blob at >=1024px -> drag Satellites to 0 -> drag Sat Radius, Orbit Radius, Eccentricity, Merge (ms), Emerge (ms): readouts change, the preview does not, and no control indicates it is inert.
defects.proposedCure: `SliderDef` gains `enabledWhen?: (config) => boolean` (or a declarative `dependsOn` path); the row renders the producer's disabled state with aria-disabled plus an explicit reason. Consumed once by glass-ui's ConfiguratorRow, not hand-rolled per consumer.

defects.defect: The prop contract erases types: both consumers must launder their real config through `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>`, and one spends a 13-line recursive mapped type reconstructing the safety the pane threw away.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:41-52 types config and defaults as Record<string, unknown>. Four double-casts: AuroraPane.vue:111, :113; BlobPane.vue:124, :126. BlobPane.vue:36-48 defines `NumericAtomPath` — a 13-line recursive mapped type with a 24-line comment on two levels of `-?` modifier stripping — solely to restore key safety.
defects.mechanism: The pane is generic over "any object addressed by any dot-path string" — the least typeable contract available — and every consumer pays for the generality. It also carries seven jobs in 252 lines with no encapsulation of any (Card shell, scroll host, dot-path resolver, number formatter, clipboard exporter, reset engine, slot host), which is edict 1 (no god modules) and edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance); the widest possible prop type is the symptom.
defects.reproduction: grep -n "as unknown" demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue
defects.proposedCure: Make the pane generic over its config: `defineProps<{config: T; sections: SliderSection<T>[]; defaults: T}>()` with SliderDef<T>["key"] a keyof-derived dot-path union. BlobPane.vue:36-48 and all four casts then delete — a net subtraction of ~30 lines. Alternatively the D-8/D-9 split removes the "generic over any object" requirement entirely.

defects.defect: The class name `pane-scroll-fade` and the component's own comment both promise a fade mask that does not exist; the scroll edge is a hard clip with zero affordance.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:104-106 claims "The scroll region owns the fade mask + overflow". Measured live: maskImage "none", webkitMaskImage "none"; the class (PaneHeader.vue unscoped block) sets only `contain: layout style paint` and `scroll-timeline: --pane-scroll`. scrollHeight 2605 vs clientHeight 695; scroll bottom 799 abuts action-bar top 799. Visible amputation in shots/safari-mobile-dark/atmosphere.png. Separately `grep -n "transition|animation|@keyframes" demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue` returns zero hits: the v-if swaps at :119/:163 are untransitioned.
defects.mechanism: Name/comment drift plus a genuinely missing affordance. Not an edict-6 violation (no animation was deleted) and not a PRM violation (nothing animates geometry; measured under reducedMotion:"reduce" the only transition is colour) — but a scroll edge with no affordance is a defect regardless of the class name.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> scrollRegion.maskImage
defects.proposedCure: Add the compositor-side mask-image the name promises, or rename the class to pane-scroll-host and correct :104-105. Given the D-9 disclosure cure the fade becomes the right answer.

defects.defect: RTL produces a half-mirrored row — the label/value pair mirrors, the track does not — and reverses the action order so the destructive Reset becomes the leading action.
defects.evidence: shots/rtl-desktop/blob.png: row reads `0.220 Body Radius`; the Body Radius thumb sits at 38% from the visual left in both LTR and RTL (LTR track 770..1200 thumb ~934; RTL track 240..670 thumb ~404 — same fraction from the left, i.e. 62% from the RTL inline-start). Action bar renders `Reset` then `Copy JSON`. The description prose breaks its terminal period onto the next line ("...and satellite" / ".behavior").
defects.mechanism: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:124 says the numeric axis sign never mirrors, so the un-mirrored track may be intended — but the row's text mirrors while its track does not, and :154 requires values to render in LTR-isolated spans inside RTL prose, which the readout does not do. The un-designed part is the combination plus the promoted destructive verb.

defects.proposedCure: Decide the axis direction explicitly at the producer (.glass-slider already supports data-inverted, which flips --slider-range-origin); wrap the readout in an LTR-isolated span; pin the action order by DOM role rather than letting flex direction choose which verb leads.

defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> truncation (in-place textContent substitution on the first .configurator-row label)
defects.proposedCure: Choose one: guarantee the measure (declare a label budget in SliderDef and enforce it at the producer row) or supply the fallback (title on truncation). Do not ship both a truncating label and no fallback.

dismissed.id: C-3 / L-6 (the "feed the variant a real gradient" cure arm)
dismissed.why: Not refuted so much as INADMISSIBLE, and it matters because a wave could regress into it. Both challengers float "feed the variant a real gradient over the slider's own domain" as an acceptable reading of the N.W13 mandate. Only the other arm — retire the variant — is admissible. result.addendumClause:
### ADD-CSP · The configurator population

**CSP-1 · Value legibility is a paint obligation, not a token obligation.** Every bounded numeric control in `ALL18` renders its value as a **painted extent**. The filled portion measures ≥3:1 against the unfilled portion of the same control, and the unfilled portion measures ≥3:1 against its ground. A control whose fill element is laid out to the value and painted with zero alpha does not satisfy this clause regardless of the contrast of any other part. **The spectral meniscus (`variant="spectrum"`) is admissible only where the track background is an actual chromatic ramp over the control's own domain — Picker and Gradient. Feeding that variant a flat colour is forbidden**, and a consumer may not re-ink a producer control's track, range or value from a certified **text** ink rung: text ink is specified for glyph mass and is not an area material.

**CSP-2 · Two channels or none.** Control extent, control fill, selection and focus are each expressed in at least two independent channels, at least one of which survives `forced-colors: active`. `background` alone is one channel; `box-shadow` with `outline-style: none` is one channel and it is the wrong one. **Focus uses `outline`.** Forced-colors conformance is proven in **Chromium** — WebKit ignores the emulation, so a WebKit forced-colors frame is not evidence and may not be tracked as one.

**CSP-3 · The configurator is producer-owned.** A consumer composes glass-ui's `Configurator`, `ConfiguratorLayer`, `ConfiguratorRow` and `useConfiguratorState`. It does not re-mint a section head, a reset engine, a surface rung, a row rhythm or a numeric formatter, and it does not reach past a published prop into a producer's internal class with `:deep()`. A demo-local generic configurator component is a defect; the section/reset/size seams have producer homes and those homes are the API.

**CSP-4 · Reset is shape-aware, confirmed and comparable.** A whole-object merge may not stand in for a declared key domain. Reset restores exactly the keys the control surface owns, announces its result in a durable status region, and is paired with a compare affordance per `OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:47`. Copy and every other command in the action region expose success, failure and pending state in that same region; a silent `await` over a two-state producer `Result` is a defect.

**CSP-5 · Depth is disclosed, not scrolled.** A control surface exceeding **two** viewport heights declares a disclosure rank per section (`essential | advanced`), renders essentials unconditionally, and confines the remainder to the producer's disclosure region with a compositor-side edge affordance. A flat list behind a hard clip is a defect, and a class named for a fade must own one.

**CSP-6 · Every control announces, groups and reserves.** Each row exposes `aria-valuetext` equal to its rendered readout; each section is a programmatic group with an accessible name; each rendered `<label>` labels its control. Live numbers use tabular figures and reserve their widest legal representation. Precision and unit derive from the **declared step and domain**, never from the current value. A control with no effect in the current model renders the producer's disabled state with an explicit reason.

**CSP-7 · The workbench has a subject.** On `/blob` and `/atmosphere` the preview region's rendered paint area exceeds the control region's at every desktop size, and the split is the exact `preview-dominant` 66.6666667 / 33.3333333. A configurator may not occupy a protagonist slot, and a protagonist slot may not be filled by a different route's instrument. At narrow width the route renders its own named subject in a single document-scrolling sequence: **no global pane selector, and no route whose default pane is not the pane it is named for.**

**CSP-8 · Ambient motion terminates or is stoppable.** A route carrying continuous renderer motion either stops within five seconds or exposes one persistent, keyboard-operable, announced and remembered still control in its action region. Reduced motion resolving to a still frame does not discharge this; it is a separate obligation.

**CSP-9 · A gate measures the cured object.** A contrast or geometry oracle names the element that carries the information. An oracle that certifies an inert surface, or that turns RED when the defect it was written for is actually fixed, is retired and re-aimed in the same cut as the cure.
result.dissent:
FOUR DISSENTS AND ONE CONCURRENCE-WITH-CAVEAT.

(1) I dissent from CHALLENGE-D on D-2's severity framing. D-2 is filed BLOCKER on the ground that the configurator is "unreachable" at mobile widths and 200% zoom. It is not unreachable — I measured a live Blob affordance with aria-pressed="false" at both arms, one tap away. The finding survives as a BLOCKER under J3-03 for two DIFFERENT reasons (the route defaults to the pane it is not named for; the recovery mechanism is itself canon-forbidden), and a wave built on the "unreachable" premise would ship the wrong cure — it would make the pane render at 390px and declare victory, leaving the forbidden global toggle and the 8.19% preview ratio in place.

(2) I dissent from CHALLENGE-D and CHALLENGE-L on the divider contrast numbers, and I record it against myself as much as against them. D-6 reports a 4.7x light/dark swing; my own first pass reported the same swing INVERTED. Both are artifacts of compositing a translucent border over black. Composited over the well the rule measures 1.24:1 and 1.29:1 — no asymmetry exists. The broader consequence: ANY contrast helper in this formation that fills #000 before filling the sample is unsound for alpha<1 colours, and several numbers already in the harvested ledger were produced that way. That is a harness defect with reach beyond this component and it should be swept across every seat's evidence.

(3) I dissent from CHALLENGE-C and CHALLENGE-L on the SHAPE of the variant="spectrum" cure. Both float "feed the variant a real gradient" as an acceptable reading of the N.W13 mandate. Only "retire the variant" is admissible. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:7 reserves the meniscus to Picker and Gradient, and Body Radius, Smooth K, Merge (ms) and Zones have no chromatic domain to ramp. Manufacturing a gradient for a geometry axis would fix the fill by devaluing the product's signature form — strictly worse than the defect. CSP-1 is written to close that door.

(4) I dissent from CHALLENGE-L's ORDERING, and this is the single most consequential disagreement in the adjudication. L proposes L-1 (reset) first, L-6 (the track) second, L-5 (tsconfig paths) third. Correctness-first is the right instinct, but it lands a cure into a tree whose only gate is ADVERSE to it: o18-contrast-census.spec.ts:1161-1213 goes RED when the track re-ink is retired, and a wave that discovers this mid-flight will be tempted to preserve the re-ink to keep the gate green — which is precisely how the T.W8 cure produced this defect in the first place. Stage A (un-lock and re-aim the gate) must precede every other stage.

CONCURRENCE WITH CAVEAT, on the transposition. I agree with L-15's greenfield lattice — that ConfigSliderPane.vue should not exist — and Stage C adopts it. My caveat: L presents this as a LIBRARY finding, and it is equally the DESIGN finding. A generic "pane parameterised by any object addressed by any dot-path string" cannot express a rank, a unit, a precision, a dependency or a compare, because it knows nothing about its domain. Five of my eighteen upheld defects (J3-06, J3-09, J3-11, J3-16, J3-18) are not oversights a diligent author would have caught — they are UNREPRESENTABLE in the current contract. That is why the verdict is apotheosis and not repair: you cannot fix, in a component, a defect whose cure the component's own type signature forbids you from expressing.

NO DISSENT on J3-01's mechanism, J3-04's mechanism, or the vacuous-gate finding. On those three all challengers converged from different premises onto the same bytes, and I reproduced each of them independently.

waveSpec.title: The configurator transposition — ConfigSliderPane stops re-implementing @mkbabb/glass-ui/configurator
waveSpec.scope: IN: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue (rewritten, generic <T>, presentation only, zero scoped CSS rules); demo/scenes/config-fields.ts (NEW — Field<T>/FieldSection<T> with typed get/set accessors, precision derived from step, explicit unit, enabledWhen predicate, essential|advanced rank, plus precisionOf/formatField/widestValue); demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue (rewritten — its 4 enum rows become EnumField entries with named per-option slots; the bare <slot/>, .aurora-row, .aurora-row-label and the whole <style> block delete); demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue (rewritten — NumericAtomPath's 13 lines + 24-line comment + s() delete); demo/scenes/atmosphere/atmosphere-calibration.ts (MOVED down out of the shell's boot chain); demo/test/config-fields.test.ts (NEW); e2e/smoke/oracles/o21-config-console.spec.ts (NEW); the re-aimed o18-contrast-census config legs. Deletions named explicitly in the report §4: readPath, writePath, read()/as number, fmt(), resetDefaults()/Object.assign/structuredClone, SliderDef+SliderSection exported from the SFC, both Record<string, unknown> prop types, the extraControls? doc line, the empty-state JSDoc promise, relative/mx-auto, the bare <slot/>, both permanently-true v-if guards, the population-clause comment, console-well on the console div, .config-section-header + .config-section-title, gap-1.5 py-1, variant="spectrum", --slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted), the :deep() font-mono re-ink, the :deep() min-block-size clamp, the whole @media (pointer: coarse) ::before block, the action-bar border-top, and the entire <style scoped> block. OUT, folded to named waves: demo/ui/ (87 remaining sites → MT·W-UISHIM), tsconfig.demo.json paths/exports drift (→ MT·W-DOGFOOD-PATHS), the three pane tables + masking return ColorPicker + blob's missing defaultPaneIndex (→ MT·W-PANETABLE), .pane-scroll-fade's class home (→ MT·W-PANESHELL-CLASS), the pane-root Card and the first InstrumentChassis adoption (→ W28/W29 obligation O-1). Five producer relays R-1..R-5 to glass-ui BH.

result.addendumClause:
**ADD-CSP — the configurator transposition.**

`demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue` is a demo-local re-implementation of `@mkbabb/glass-ui/configurator`, authored by a file that imports from that package and consumes one of its five exports. It re-mints the section (`ConfiguratorLayer`), the state (`useConfiguratorState`), the scroll port (`FadingScroll`), the row rhythm (the `size` axis), the seated surface (`.configurator-layer`) and the reset affordance (`ConfiguratorRow.canReset`), and it pays for that generality with a stringly-typed reflection layer — `Record<string, unknown>`, dot-path strings, `read(): number` over a provably-`undefined` value, and four `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>` casts at the call sites — whose shape-blindness silently destroys live application state on every Reset (measured: `color.paletteStops` `["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"]` → `["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"]`).

The cure is a transposition, not a patch. The schema moves to `demo/scenes/config-fields.ts` as `Field<T>` / `FieldSection<T>` carrying typed `get`/`set` accessors, `precision` derived from `step`, an explicit `unit`, an `enabledWhen` dependency predicate and an `essential | advanced` disclosure rank. Reset becomes an iteration over the declared fields, which makes the clobber **unrepresentable** rather than merely guarded. Sections become `ConfiguratorLayer`s — announced, collapsible, and materially seated by the producer — so `.console-well`, both `.config-section-*` rules, all eight forbidden dividing lines and the second surface tier delete together. Row rhythm rides `provideConfiguratorSize()`, deleting a `:deep()` clamp measured 25px below the row's natural height (35.84px against 60.97px) and a coarse-pointer hit extension measured to add exactly zero (`max(100%, 44px)` = 100%). The scroll port becomes `FadingScroll axis="y"`, delivering the feather the class name `pane-scroll-fade` has promised and never rendered (`maskImage: "none"`, 2611/695 = 3.76 screens hard-clipped). `AuroraPane`'s bare `<slot />` — which licensed a second control-row species whose label recipe is a byte-identical five-declaration copy of the pane's *section-heading* recipe — is replaced by typed enum fields with named per-option slots, deleting that pane's entire `<style>` block; `BlobPane`'s 37-line `NumericAtomPath` mapped type deletes because typed accessors check the value, not the key literal. The pane's own `<style scoped>` block goes to zero rules: a component that composes correctly emits no corrections.

**The value-read cure is not the variant retirement all three challengers prescribe.** Measured live, flipping only `data-variant` and mutating nothing else: `spectrum` renders `.slider-range { background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0) }` with a 12 × 24 handle, and `standard` renders `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` with a `0 × 20`, opacity-0 handle. Both recipes leave the filled extent unpainted on this surface, and the prescribed cure removes the last remaining value cue. The wave therefore *measures before it chooses*, and feeds the producer's published `--slider-range-bg` seam once at the console root — the exact idiom `ComponentSliders.vue:193-201` uses for `--slider-track-bg`, root-level and edict-5 clean — moving one token from the inert groove to the filled extent and inverting figure and ground with a single declaration. The `o18` GRAPHICS leg re-aims from *track vs well* to *range vs track*: it currently certifies the inert channel, which is why it reads green while no slider in the pane indicates its value.

The wave opens RED: 18 of 18 gates fail against `tranche-u @ c654824e`, proven by the committed runnable gate at `docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ConfigSliderPane/gates/csp-gate.mjs` (exit 1). Four repo-level defects this component merely sits downstream of — the 19-barrel `demo/ui` alias shim (90 shim imports against 37 bare-barrel and 82 subpath), the `tsconfig.demo.json` ↔ `package.json#exports` drift that typechecks the demo's `@mkbabb/value.js/css` imports against a different `.d.ts` than it executes, the three string-keyed pane tables ending in a masking `return ColorPicker` with `blob` missing the `defaultPaneIndex` its siblings set, and `.pane-scroll-fade`'s leaf-emitted global class — fold to `MT·W-UISHIM`, `MT·W-DOGFOOD-PATHS`, `MT·W-PANETABLE` and `MT·W-PANESHELL-CLASS`, each chartered with its own RED-today gate. Five producer asks (R-1 the two incomplete Slider recipes, R-2 `aria-valuetext` pass-through and a `ConfiguratorRow` label id, R-3 a domain-scoped reset, R-4 a forced-colors arm matching the one the producer already ships for `.disclosure-*`, R-5 `--slider-range-bg` documented as a public seam) relay to glass-ui BH under the standing relay edict. The pane-root `<Card tier="resting">` and the first `InstrumentChassis` adoption are named obligations on W28/W29, not carries. The standing `C10 A4 [P1]` book closes by supersession, with its residual ask carried upstream as R-3. No item in this clause is re-booked.
result.dissent:
FIVE dissents, each byte-grounded.

(1) AGAINST ALL THREE CHALLENGERS, ON THE VALUE-READ CURE. D-3/D-14, L-6 and C-3 independently converge on "drop `variant='spectrum'` and the producer's default `.slider-range` will paint the filled extent." I measured the proposition directly (flip only `data-variant`, mutate no custom property): shipped/spectrum → rangeBg `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`, shadow `none`, thumb 12×24 opacity 1; flip-only/standard → rangeBg `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`, a fully transparent rim shadow, thumb `0 × 20` opacity 0. BOTH recipes leave the extent unpainted here, and the prescribed cure removes the last remaining value cue. `--liquid-fill-tint` resolves correctly on that element (`oklch(0.88 0.1 75)`) and a bare `<div class="glass-liquid-fill">` in the same subtree paints (`oklab(0.88 0.0259 0.0966 / 0.88)`), so this is not a demo token misconfiguration. Most probable mechanism — labelled a HYPOTHESIS, the observation is not — `.glass-liquid-fill` lives in `@layer components` (dist/styles/glass/liquid-fill.css) while every SFC-scoped `.slider-range[data-v-4f4cab01]` rule in dist/glass-ui.css is unlayered, and unlayered beats every layered declaration. The defect (A-2) is a BLOCKER and stands; the cure is a producer relay plus a root-level `--slider-range-bg` feed, and G2 is written as an experiment with a deterministic fallback rather than as an assumption.

(2) AGAINST C-1 / C-9 / L-1 / L-4 AND THE STANDING C10 A4 BOOK, ON RESET. They converge on adopting `useConfiguratorState<T>`. Its `resetCurrent()` is documented "Restore `config` to the active preset's baseline" — the same whole-object semantics that produced the BLOCKER — and its `clone` hook is documented for "shapes that contain unclonable values", a different problem. Making `color.paletteStops` survive would require a hand-written cloner reaching into the shape: exactly the shape-knowledge the generic component was not supposed to need, moved one level out where a future consumer gets it wrong the same way. Domain-scoped reset — iterate the declared fields, write each one's default through its own setter — makes the clobber UNREPRESENTABLE in three lines with no new dependency, because `color.paletteStops` is not a field and therefore no code path can reach it. C-1's own report reaches this in its final sentence ("the only form that cannot lie") and then recommends the other thing; I take the sentence over the recommendation. `useConfiguratorState` is RETIRED for this component and relay R-3 carries the residual ask upstream.

(3) AGAINST L-4, ON COMPOSING `<Configurator>` WHOLE. It is a studio, not a section stack: `configurator-M5OaIlJd.js` renders `class="configurator glass-floating rounded-panel border border-border/60"` over a `configurator-stage` / `configurator-aside` CSS grid (`components/configurator/styles.css`, `[data-slot="configurator"]`). Nesting a `glass-floating` studio inside the pane's `glass-resting` Card creates a THIRD surface tier and a stage this pane has no stage for — worsening A-8, not curing it, against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:19 "One surface has one tier." The size axis it was invoked for needs no chassis: `provideConfiguratorSize()` is a standalone export from `configurator/size.d.ts`. The correct decomposition takes the four leaf primitives (`provideConfiguratorSize`, `ConfiguratorLayer`, `ConfiguratorRow`, `FadingScroll`) and leaves the chassis unused.

(4) AGAINST D-8, ON SCOPE. `grep -rn "InstrumentChassis" demo` → 0 hits: the demo has never adopted it. Doing so for one pane is a shell-wide chassis migration across the 9 panes sharing `.pane-scroll-fade`, and OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md assigns Atmosphere/Blob chassis closure to W28/W29. Eight sibling panes root a `<Card tier="resting">`, so retiring it here alone breaks isomorphism with all eight and o7 already excludes this component from its runtime walk. The defect stands; the component-scope cure is deleting the INNER `.console-well`, taking the surface count 2 → 1 and handing W28/W29 a pane already one tier from compliant. The pane-root Card retirement is a NAMED obligation (O-1), not a carry.

(5) AGAINST L-7 AND L-13, ON EXTRACTION AS A CURE. L proposes three new shared modules; I take exactly one (the schema), because it is the only one that removes a concept rather than relocating it. A `demo/shared/config-path.ts` with symmetric guards promotes the reflection layer to a repo-wide primitive and ships a well-tested wrong abstraction — a guarded `readPath` cannot restore the type the string erased, and cannot make A-1 unrepresentable. A `demo/shared/PaneShell.vue` is a new wrapper component that does not exist, which edict 3 forbids, and would rewrite 9 panes to solve a class-home problem whose honest fix is a two-line move to `foundation.css`. Extracting plumbing you should be deleting is how a defect becomes a platform.

NO DISSENT on the underlying defects: I upheld every BLOCKER and MAJOR the three challengers raised except where the bytes refuted the claim (L-16 only). Where they described one mechanism in three vocabularies I merged them — A-2 absorbs D-3/D-4/D-14/L-6/C-3, A-3 absorbs C-5/C-11b/C-11c/D-16/L-7/L-8, A-13 absorbs D-5/C-8/L-11, A-22 absorbs L-10/D-2/C-13.

defects.defect: `writeClipboard`'s discriminated `CopyResult` is discarded — a denied clipboard is indistinguishable from success — in a library whose own description advertises failure-explicitness.

Repo-wide: 3 sites use `useClipboard` with real status (App.vue:362, MixResultDisplay.vue:31, GradientEasingEditor.vue:94) and ~9 call `writeClipboard` bare, 7 with `void` or a discarded await.
defects.mechanism: Two clipboard-feedback regimes alive at once; the pane picked the one with no feedback surface, so the Copy button cannot report failure.
defects.reproduction: NONE — source read; a live repro would require revoking clipboard permission.
defects.proposedCure: One home: adopt `useClipboard` at the pane and drive the Copy button's confirmed state from `status`. Under the greenfield cure this becomes a Configurator footer affordance.

defects.defect: Generic, dependency-free object-graph plumbing is trapped inside an SFC and is half-guarded; the public contract types are exported from a `.vue`, so any consumer of the type must import the component.

defects.reproduction: NONE. Positive check: dot-path traversal has exactly ONE home — `grep -rn 'split(".")' demo/ src/` returns only this file. No duplication to report.

result.strongestDefect: L-1 — `resetDefaults()` (ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94) is a shape-blind `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))` that destroys the live picker→blob palette coupling and leaves it destroyed until the picker colour next changes. Reproduced end-to-end in Node against the real `BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS` and the real `useAtmosphere.ts:389-401` watch shape: after Reset, `color.paletteStops` reverts to the stock cream ramp `["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"]` and the derive count stays at 1 through a 50 ms settle — only a new picker colour restores it. Four further non-slider atoms (`quality`, `morphT`, `satellites.absorbedDuration`, `surface.rimColor`) are silently reverted with it. The mechanism is pure library structure: the pane's props erase the config's shape to `Record<string, unknown>`, so the only reset it can express is "overwrite everything" — while `@mkbabb/glass-ui/configurator`, already imported on line 21, ships `useConfiguratorState<T>.resetCurrent()` (restore-to-baseline) and per-row `canReset`/`@reset`. It is the sharpest instance of the report's unifying finding (L-3): a configurator hand-rolled inside a feature area over a design system that already ships the configurator.
result.negativeProof:
Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so this field records (a) the one prior-round finding I REFUTED by measurement and (b) the items I probed and found sound — both matter for the fold.

REFUTED. The r1 report at this path claimed the root-barrel import at ConfigSliderPane.vue:23 costs "25,239 B / 46 chunks where 4,179 B / 6 would do". That compares entry-file sizes, not shipped bytes. glass-ui declares `"sideEffects": ["*.css"]`, so its JS is tree-shakeable. Measured with two synthetic entries bundled identically (`npx esbuild --bundle --format=esm --minify` with vue/reka-ui/@vueuse/@lucide/value.js/keyframes/pencil-boil/embla external): barrel entry `import { Button, Card, Slider, writeClipboard } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui"` = 82,616 B; subpath entry `from "@mkbabb/glass-ui/{button,card,slider,dom}"` = 82,620 B. The subpath version is 4 bytes LARGER. Any byte-cost claim for the barrel must be withdrawn; L-4 stands on one-home/dual-path grounds only. The 78-module/297,935 B vs 50-module/143,606 B static-import-graph figures are a dev-server module-graph measure and must not be quoted as bundle cost.

CHECKED AND SOUND:
- Dot-path traversal has exactly one home — `grep -rn 'split(".")' demo/ src/` returns only ConfigSliderPane.vue:59,67. No second object walker.
- `DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS` correctly omits `seed` (aurora-atoms.ts:53-77), so `Object.assign` cannot clobber the picker colour on the aurora side. L-1 is blob-only; the author anticipated the defect class on one pane and missed it on the other, which is the ownership argument rather than a second bug.
- Every slider key is live today: `noise`, `colorEnergy`, `zones.count` all exist on `AuroraAtomsBase` (atoms.d.ts:141-152); BlobPane's 31 dot-paths are compiler-guarded by `NumericAtomPath`.
- `verbatimModuleSyntax` is honoured — both type-only imports of `SliderSection` are `import type` (AuroraPane.vue:34, BlobPane.vue:15).
- Vue 3.5 idioms are correct: reactive props destructure at :41; no template refs needed; no `defineModel` stale-read hazard (the pane writes through an injected reactive object).
- `--slider-track-bg` is a genuine producer token (two `var(--slider-track-bg, …)` sites in glass-ui.css), and the override sits on the container `.config-console`, not per instance.
- `.console-well` is legitimately global — two consumers, one home (foundation.css:350), documented, compliant with DESIGN.md:388.
- Animations: nothing deleted; the scroll-driven pane-header choreography stays with its producer and the coarse-pointer rules are additive.
- `@mkbabb/value.js/css` resolves correctly to this checkout's own dist via package self-reference (traceResolution pasted) — the hoisted npm copy is NOT what the demo typechecks against, so there is no stale-artifact defect there despite the two files differing.
- OUT OF SCOPE, already booked: `dist/gh-pages/assets/` contains 2 JS files totalling 12,472 B with a 698 B entry (the known W44 §F prod-preview empty-mount carry). I therefore could not measure the real production bundle and did not claim to.

result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`, the tier declared at spawn. Declared, not inherited. No defect on the receipt axis.
result.strongestDefect: L-1 — the demo module lattice is documentation, not law. `eslint --print-config` proves the subject component AND its composables resolve `no-restricted-imports` to UNSET/OFF, because all three lattice objects in eslint.config.js:232-301 are keyed on `demo/@/**` — a tree W43 deleted (`ls -d demo/@` → No such file) — and ban `@components/custom/...` aliases tsconfig.demo.json:32-34 records as killed. Vacuous twice over. `strictTemplates` is unset in every tsconfig, so unknown component props are never reported either. This is the enabling condition: every other finding (the cross-`demo/` content cycle, the 4-hop reach into color-session internals, the global-stylesheet import from a scene leaf, the glass-ui props that do not exist) is something a live lattice would have refused. NOTE: this supersedes the prior seat's headline BLOCKER, which I REFUTED — see negativeProof.
result.negativeProof:
REFUTATION OF THE PRIOR SEAT'S BLOCKER (the most important negative). The 2026-07-24 CHALLENGE-L report's strongest claim was that the demo typechecks `@mkbabb/value.js/css` against the published npm tarball while running against the local build ("9 demo files typecheck against the tarball… the gate meant to catch a parser regression cannot see the parser"). REFUTED by measurement. I re-ran its `/tmp/probe.ts` repro verbatim and reproduced its result (`/css` → node_modules/@mkbabb/value.js/dist/subpaths/css.d.ts). I then ran the REAL demo program on the REAL subject file: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit --traceResolution` prints "File '/Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/package.json' exists… Entering conditional exports… Using 'exports' subpath './css' with target './dist/subpaths/css.d.ts'" and resolves to the REPO dist. `grep "'@mkbabb/value.js/css' was successfully resolved" | sort -u` over the whole program returns exactly ONE line — the repo build — for all 10 import sites. Zero demo files reach node_modules. Mechanism of the artifact: TS's exports self-resolution walks up from the IMPORTER to the nearest ancestor package.json matching the specifier's package; a file inside the repo finds the repo's own package.json and self-resolves, a file in /tmp cannot and falls through to node_modules. The probe's LOCATION produced the finding. The "Package ID …@4.0.0" annotation that misled the prior seat is TS labelling package identity, not evidence of a node_modules hop. Retracted with it: the Color_2 type-fork argument and the V·π blast radius.

OTHER PROVED NEGATIVES: (1) The named historical suspect "three parallel useDark stores (useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:76)" is CURED — `grep -rn "useDark\|useGlobalDark" demo/ src/` returns 11 call sites, ALL `useGlobalDark` from @mkbabb/glass-ui/dark, ZERO vueuse useDark; line 76 is the comment describing the landed cure. (2) Import SPECIFIERS are honest — all 45 demo library imports use bare published subpath keys (color 25, css 10, math 6, easing 5, quantize 4), every one a real `exports` key, and `grep -rn "@src" demo/ assets/` → 0, so no deep src/ import exists; a real npm consumer could write useMarkdownColors.ts:3-4 verbatim. (3) No demo-side duplicate of the contrast walk — ink.ts:1-12 imports safeAccentColor from the published subpath and certifyAccentInk is a thin policy wrapper over it (src/color/operations.ts:207). (4) No second markdown renderer exists (one component, one consumer). (5) verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied in all four module files. (6) Vue 3.5 idioms correct — useTemplateRef, reactive props destructure, getters into composables; `ref()` holding a module namespace is NOT a deep-reactivity defect (namespaces are non-extensible → Vue's getTargetType returns INVALID). (7) Animations preserved — the sole transition (line 125) rides live h2/h3 rules and moves with them. (8) Katex.vue:20's script-side stylesheet import is the correct cure, verified live (9 .katex, 4 .katex-display nodes render).

Not glass-ui: glass-ui@7.0.0 exports 73 subpaths and none is prose/typography/markdown, and the φ ladder + --md-color-* are value.js-doc-specific — the demo style layer (peer of animations.css/utils.css/hljs.css) is the correct home, which satisfies edict 4 and edict 3 (relocation, not a new abstraction).

defects.defect: `useMarkdownColors` is a hand copy of `useSafeAccentFn("resting")`, and `color-session` exported a pure one-line alias (`resolveSurfaceLightnessLive`) solely to enable the copy — which then omits the mount-epoch bump the module's own contract declares mandatory, and applies a second, contradictory failure policy.
defects.evidence: Canonical: useContrastSafeColor.ts:345-365 `useSafeAccentFn` = useGlobalDark + inject(INK_AMBIENT_KEY) + bumpProbeEpochOnMount + certifyAccentInk(css, surfaceLightnessNow(surface, ambient, isDark), floor). Copy: useMarkdownColors.ts:18,25,44-73 = the identical four steps, hand-assembled via a 4-hop reach into three color-session files (useMarkdownColors.ts:5-7). The enabling export: useContrastSafeColor.ts:370-376 `resolveSurfaceLightnessLive` is `return surfaceLightnessNow(surface, ambientL, dark);` — a pure pass-through for a private function, whose docstring names this component as the beneficiary. Contract violation: useContrastSafeColor.ts:69-77 states a folder "must register the mount bump from its setup"; `grep -rn bumpProbeEpochOnMount demo/` → ConsoleRail.vue:133 ✓, useViewAccents.ts:89 ✓, useContrastSafeColor.ts:300,:348 ✓ internal — useMarkdownColors ABSENT, HeroBlob.vue:99 ABSENT. Failure-policy split: ink.ts:136 `if (!accent) return css;` (benign) vs useMarkdownColors.ts:33/37/41 `throw new Error(...)` from inside a computed the template reads via :style="mdColorVars".
defects.mechanism: a composable duplicated by copy instead of parameterised, and a module surface widened to serve the duplicate; the duplicate then drifts from the original's contract on two axes (lifecycle registration and error policy)
defects.reproduction: Structural, proven by the three sources above. SYMPTOM REPRODUCTION: NONE — the missing epoch bump is a HYPOTHESIS as to observable effect. In the live app the boot writer's useContrastSafeColor bumps the epoch at App mount, which self-heals the first read; I did not reproduce a wrong paint. The CONTRACT VIOLATION is proven; the SYMPTOM is not.
defects.proposedCure: Consume the composable instead of copying it: `const { safeCss } = useSafeAccentFn("resting"); const accent = safeCss(`oklch(${L} ${headingC} ${headingH})`)`. 3 deep imports → 1; the epoch bump becomes structurally impossible to omit because there is nothing to omit; the throw-in-computed becomes a `{}` degenerate letting inherited ink stand (value.js's published contract is failure-EXPLICIT; a consumer answering !parsed.ok with throw re-introduces the exception channel at the render boundary). Then DELETE resolveSurfaceLightnessLive and migrate the other two folded call sites (HeroBlob.vue:99, ConsoleRail.vue:136, useViewAccents.ts:108) the same way.

defects.defect: `resetDefaults()` uses a depth-1 `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))`, so any live state at depth ≥2 inside a key that also exists on `defaults` is destroyed. On /#/blob it wipes `color.paletteStops` — the picker-derived ramp owned by an external watch — and the watch is keyed on the colour string so it does not re-fire until the user picks a DIFFERENT colour. Silent, no undo, no visible symptom.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94; writer at demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:389-402. Live probe (scratchpad/probe.mjs, Chromium vs localhost:9000, PUBLIC UI ONLY — Copy JSON → Reset → Copy JSON, clipboard intercepted, no Vue internals): `BLOB pre-reset color.paletteStops: ["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"]` → `BLOB post-reset color.paletteStops: ["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"]`. Replacement value confirmed at node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/presets-5myqNv59.js:27-32. Aurora control arm same session: seed survives (`"seed":"lab(92% 88.8 20)"` pre and post) only because aurora-atoms.ts:17-20 deliberately omits it — a consumer-side convention the generic component neither expresses nor enforces.
defects.mechanism: The stringly-typed reflection layer has no notion of WHICH keys the pane owns, so reset guesses "all top-level keys of defaults". The `sections` prop already declares the owned key domain and is ignored.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/probe.mjs — or by hand: open http://localhost:9000/#/blob, click Copy JSON (paste to see the 4-stop picker-derived ramp), click Reset, click Copy JSON again (3-stop tan triad ['#b5947f','#d4b27d','#dad6b1']). Reproduced byte-identically in two independent audit passes a session apart, via two different instruments.
defects.proposedCure: Reset the DECLARED key domain, not the object: iterate `sections[].defs[].key` and `writePath` each from `defaults`. That makes the reset domain identical to the edit domain by construction, cannot touch an externally-owned member, and makes aurora's seed-omission convention unnecessary. Alternatively adopt glass-ui's `useConfiguratorState<T>` with its `clone` hook — the still-open C10 A4 [P1] book (docs/tranches/N/audit/lanes/C10.md:92-105, :265).

defects.defect: NEW in this pass. `copyAsJson` stringifies the whole reactive proxy, so Copy and Reset model two DIFFERENT objects in opposite directions: Reset excludes `AuroraAtoms.seed` (correct) while Copy exports it; Reset clobbers `BlobConfig.color.paletteStops` while Copy exports it. The copied 'preset' therefore freezes the live picker coupling that aurora-atoms.ts exists to preserve, and is the delivery vehicle that hands D-1's corrupted state to the user.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90. Measured payloads (scratchpad/probe.mjs, navigator.clipboard.writeText intercepted, real button clicks): AURORA keys `harmony,colorEnergy,zones,noise,medium,motion,interactivity,seed` with `"seed":"lab(92% 88.8 20)"` (270 bytes); BLOB keys `geometry,satellites,membrane,color,surface,interaction,morphT,quality,tempo` with `color.paletteStops:["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"]` (1412 bytes) — `morphT` and `quality` are driven by no slider, and BlobPane.vue:8-9 calls paletteStops 'the live picker-palette feed … not a slider'.

defects.defect: `variant="spectrum"` is declared on 31 non-spectrum scalar knobs and then has its entire visual contract overridden away. The spectrum recipe zeroes the filled range by design (it expects the track to BE the value scale); painting the track a flat opaque slab leaves neither a gradient nor a filled/unfilled split, so the control carries no value affordance at all beyond a 12px thumb. The dark slab also reads inverted — the eye takes the solid bar for the filled portion.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 (variant), :202 (--slider-track-bg override). Measured live: `trackBg "oklch(0.447121 0.00386159 34.63)"` (chroma 0.0039 = achromatic), `trackBgImage "none"`, `rangeBg "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) | none"`. Producer recipe: glass-ui.css `.glass-slider[data-variant=spectrum] .slider-range{background:0 0}`. Visual: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png frames 31 charcoal slabs beside the picker's four true spectrum sliders in the same capture. N.W13's mandate ('Feed ConfigSliderPane the real --slider-track-bg gradient so its spectrum variant shows a spectrum') was discharged by substituting a flat contrast ink; U20b reads GREEN.
defects.mechanism: A variant chosen for its material, then patched demo-side to cure a contrast symptom the variant choice itself created — masking rather than transposition.
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/blob and read any slider's computed styles, or view shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png against the picker card in the same frame.
defects.proposedCure: Use `variant="standard"`, whose filled `.slider-range` reads the value for free and carries its own certified material; drop the `--slider-track-bg` override entirely. Re-run the o18 GRAPHICS leg as the gate. If a spectrum is genuinely wanted, feed the variant the value's own domain ramp — but do not declare a variant and delete its contract.

defects.defect: `copyAsJson` discards the producer's discriminated `{ok}` Result. `writeClipboard` NEVER rejects — it returns `{ok:false, reason:'no-api'|'clipboard-api'}` — so both documented failure modes are completely silent, and so is success. The `async` keyword is decorative: nothing is awaited after the call.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90. Contract at node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/composables/dom/useClipboard.d.ts:33-37 — 'the honest primitive … for consumers that own their own feedback … `const { ok } = await writeClipboard(text)`'. Measured post-click DOM (probe.mjs, /#/atmosphere): `{"liveRegions":[],"btnText":["Copy JSON","Reset"]}` — label unchanged, zero aria-live regions in the pane. `no-api` is live for this repo: navigator.clipboard is secure-context-gated and vite.config.ts sets `server.host: true` specifically so the demo is driven from a phone over http://<LAN-ip>:9000.
